basic_details.job_title: CUJ Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Environmental Sciences at Central University of Jammu is filling two temporary Project Associate-I posts in the ISRO-GBP: ARFI sponsored project "Regional Characterization of Atmospheric Aerosols from selected distinct locations of India", under Principal Investigator Dr. Shweta Yadav. The monthly fellowship is Rs. 37,000 + HRA or Rs. 30,000 + HRA, depending on how the scholar qualified. The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Environmental Sciences/Atmospheric Sciences/Earth Sciences. Applications go by post or e-mail and must be sent by 23 November 2026. The ass

how_to_apply: Prepare the application on plain paper mentioning your contact details, using the Application Form printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice (Ref No.: CUJ/ARFI/2026/02).
Attach a CV, academic transcripts, a work certificate (if any) and a 1-page motivation letter stating previous research experience and interests.
Attach self-attested testimonials; the application form also asks for attested copies of the certificates.
If posting, write the post name and the reference number on top of the envelope.
Post it to: Dr. Shweta Yadav (Principal Investigator), D-35, Department of Environmental Sciences, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Distt. Samba- 181143, Jammu(J&K), India.
Or e-mail it to [email protected]. The contact number printed is 8700244971.

The Application Form asks for: name of the post applied for, name in block letters, father's/spouse's name, date of birth, domicile, nationality, Aadhaar number, permanent and postal addresses with PIN code, mobile number, e-mail ID, whether UGC/CSIR-NET/JRF qualified, educational qualification (class/degree, year of passing, subjects, university/institute, percentage/CGPA, division/grades), experience, and the minimum time required to join if selected. It ends with a declaration and the applicant's signature.
important_instructions: The selected individual may be assigned any other duties from time to time commensurate with his/her qualifications. Fulfilling the minimum qualifications alone does not guarantee a call for interview. For further details, the notice refers candidates to the university website www.cujammu.ac.in.

content_sections.heading: CUJ Project Associate-I at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Regional Characterization of Atmospheric Aerosols from selected distinct locations of India
Indian Space Research Organization – Geosphere Biosphere Programme: Aerosol Radiative Forcing over India (ISRO-GBP: ARFI)
Monthly fellowship Rs. 37,000/- + HRA or Rs. 30,000/- + HRA

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no age limit and no experience requirement beyond the desirable qualification. Mere fulfilling of the minimum qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Environmental Sciences/Atmospheric Sciences/Earth Sciences
rows.desirable: Working knowledge of sampling and analysis of atmospheric aerosols and experience in air quality studies

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is purely on a temporary basis, with a possibility of extension based on the performance of the candidate and availability of fund in the project. The tenure of the assignment is 31st March 2027. The HRA rate is not specified in the notice.

rows.category_of_scholar: (i) Scholars selected through (a) CSIR/UGC-NET (Assistant Professorship) or GATE, or (b) a selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions
(ii) Others who do not fall under (i)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUJ Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Prepare the application on plain paper mentioning your contact details, using the Application Form printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice (Ref No.: CUJ/ARFI/2026/02). Attach a CV, academic transcripts, a work certificate (if any) and a 1-page motivation letter stating previous research experience and interests. Attach self-attested testimonials; the application form also asks for attested copies of the certificates. If posting, write the post name and the reference number on top of the envelope. Post it to: Dr. Shweta Yadav (Principal Investigator), D-35, Department of Environmental Sciences, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Distt. Samba- 181143, Jammu(J&K), India. Or e-mail it to [email protected] . The contact number printed is 8700244971. The Application Form asks for: name of the post applied for, name in block letters, father's/spouse's name, date of birth, domicile, nationality, Aadhaar number, permanent and postal addresses with PIN code, mobile number, e-mail ID, whether UGC/CSIR-NET/JRF qualified, educational qualification (class/degree, year of passing, subjects, university/institute, percentage/CGPA, division/grades), experience, and the minimum time required to join if selected. It ends with a declaration and the applicant's signature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview on merit and informed by e-mail. The decision of the selection committee is final. Shortlisted candidates must appear in person with originals of degree certificates (one set of Xerox) and date of birth proof, along with other relevant information such as experience certificate, copies of publications, awards and recommendation letters. The interview date and venue are not given in the notice. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected individual may be assigned any other duties from time to time commensurate with his/her qualifications. Fulfilling the minimum qualifications alone does not guarantee a call for interview. For further details, the notice refers candidates to the university website www.cujammu.ac.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate-I posts are advertised by Central University of Jammu?
faq.answer: Two Project Associate-I posts are advertised under the ISRO-GBP: ARFI sponsored project, on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CUJ Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 23 November 2026 (23.11.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CUJ Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Environmental Sciences/Atmospheric Sciences/Earth Sciences. Working knowledge of sampling and analysis of atmospheric aerosols and experience in air quality studies are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the fellowship for CUJ Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Scholars selected through CSIR/UGC-NET (Assistant Professorship), GATE or a national level examination conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions get Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month. Others get Rs. 30,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, both fellowship amounts are printed as "+ HRA", so HRA is mentioned in addition to Rs. 37,000/- and Rs. 30,000/-. The notice does not give the HRA rate.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for CUJ Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Send the application form with a CV, academic transcripts, work certificate (if any), a 1-page motivation letter and self-attested testimonials by post or e-mail. The e-mail address is [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The post name and the reference number (CUJ/ARFI/2026/02) must be written on top of the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted for interview on merit and informed by e-mail. The selection committee's decision is final.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CUJ Project Associate-I job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary assignment with a tenure of 31st March 2027. An extension is possible based on the candidate's performance and availability of fund in the project.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
